title: Warmly Roasted Tunisian Lamb Sandwich
description: A shaggy, post-workout Tunisian dish featuring roasted lamb, english muffins, and pickle, made shojin-friendly by using vegetable broth and omitting animal by-products.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together vegetable broth, olive oil, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Transfer the lamb to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast for 20 minutes.
While the lamb is roasting, toast the english muffins.
After the lamb has roasted for 20 minutes, remove it from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Assemble the sandwiches by spreading a layer of pickle slices on each english muffin, followed by a few pieces of the roasted lamb.
Serve the sandwiches warm and enjoy.
Let the leftovers cool completely before refrigerating or freezing.
Reheat the leftovers to an internal temperature of 165 degrees Fahrenheit before serving.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
